فِى عَيْنِهِ قُضْأَةٌ : see 1. ―
-b2- One says also, مَا عَلَيْكَ فِى هٰذَا الأَمْرِ قُضْأَةٌ i. e. [There is not] any disgrace [to be imputed to thee in, or in respect of, this affair]. (S, O.) And فِى حَسَبِهِ قُضْأَةٌ (S, O, K) and ↓ قَضْأَةٌ (K) [In his grounds of pretension to respect or honour is] faultiness, (S, O, K,) and unsoundness. (K.) And نَكَحَ فِى قُضْأَةٍ (S, O, TA) He married in a disparaging manner. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
